## “Successful One Day Innovation and Entrepreneurship Outreach Program in Schools Organized by Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC) of MGIT and Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC)”

News Date : 09 Feb 2023News ReportMandal Parishad Upper Primary School, Khanapur was the site of a successful interactive mentoring session on Thursday, 9thFebruary, 2023. The session was organized by the Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC) of MGIT in association with the Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC) as a part of their One Day Innovation and Entrepreneurship Outreach Program in schoolsDr. P Krishna, Managing Director of S. K Enterprises, was the chief guest of the event and inspired the students with his speech on entrepreneurship and business values. He emphasized the importance of giving back to the community and never forgetting one’s roots.Dr. M. Sreevani, Vice-President of IIC, and Ms. K.C. Sabitha, Convener of IIC, along with other IIC members of MGIT attended the event and interacted with the students, discussing the significance of innovation and entrepreneurship in everyday life. The students were given a perspective on how innovation works by peer group demonstrations, and innovative models were built and exhibited by the students of MGIT.The event was a great success under the leadership of Dr. G. Chandramohan Reddy, Principal of MGIT, and the guidance of Dr. K. Sudhakar Reddy, President of IIC. The session introduced the students to the world of entrepreneurship and innovation and inspired them to become future leaders in these fields.
